question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets, and what authorization, redaction, retention, export, and command-execution boundaries must those widgets follow?
rationale: The feature is aligned with operator ergonomics, but it creates a new sensitive-data surface and depends on unmerged dashboard and binding contracts that automation should not choose on its own.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Model
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/binding model first, then implement only against approved log/output contracts.

options.title: Allow A Narrow Read-Only Widget
options.body: Permit a focused follow-up limited to existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded output, excluding new command execution and generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets or decide the capability should live outside core distribution.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Model
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/binding model first, then implement only against approved log/output contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest merged-history signal for the plugin-tab seam and terminal output replay surface that this feature would build on.
